data.name: Dark Breaker
data.detailed_description:
Trapped on a hostile planet where towering forests conceal relentless mechanical predators, you are the last survivor in a world ruled by cold, unfeeling machines. In Dark Breaker, danger does not come from a single direction—countless bipedal robots hunt you from every angle, closing in without pause.

Armed with powerful weapons and devastating abilities, you must carve a path through endless waves of enemies. Every encounter is a test of reflexes, positioning, and survival instinct. Unleash explosive special effects to break through encirclement, but be prepared—the pressure never stops.

The forest is alive with threat and tension. Shadows hide incoming enemies, red eyes glow through the fog, and every second you survive pushes you deeper into chaos. There is no safe zone, no escape—only the fight to endure.

How long can you last when the machines never stop coming?

Key Features:

  • Endless waves of aggressive, intelligent robotic enemies

  • Fast-paced combat with impactful weapons and special abilities

  • Dark, atmospheric forest setting filled with constant danger

  • Survival-focused gameplay with escalating difficulty

  • Intense pressure from all directions—stay alert or be overwhelmed

Survive the hunt. Break the darkness.

data.short_description: Countless dangerous robots will constantly chase and surround you from every direction. Use your weapons and stunning special effects to destroy incoming mechanical enemies. Face endless enemy waves, withstand continuous pressure, and strive to survive in this terrifying yet exciting forest.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
